#include <bits/stdc++.h>
using namespace std;

class InputReader {
public:
    InputReader() {}
    InputReader(istream &stream) : reader(stream.rdbuf()) {}
    
    string next() {
        string token;
        while (token.empty()) {
            string line;
            getline(reader, line);
            if (reader.eof()) break;
            stringstream ss(line);
            ss >> token;
        }
        return token;
    }
    
    int nextInt() {
        int x;
        reader >> x;
        return x;
    }
    
private:
    stringstream reader;
};

class TaskF {
public:
    void solve(InputReader &in, ostream &out) {
        int N = in.nextInt();
        const int MOD = 1000000007;
        vector<vector<vector<int>>> dp(N+1, vector<vector<int>>(N+1, vector<int>(2, 0)));
        
        for (int x = N; x >= 0; --x) {
            for (int y = N; y >= 0; --y) {
                int d1 = 0, d2 = 0;
                
                if (x+1 <= N) {
                    int m = max(dp[x+1][y][0], dp[x+1][y][1]);
                    d2 += m;
                }
                d2 %= MOD;
                if (y+1 <= min(x, N)) {
                    int m = max(dp[x][y+1][0], dp[x][y+1][1]);
                    d2 += m;
                }
                d2 %= MOD;
                
                if (x+1 <= N) {
                    int m = max(dp[x+1][y][0], dp[x+1][y][1]);
                    d1 = max(d1, (1 + d2 - m + dp[x+1][y][1]) % MOD);
                    if (d1 < 0) d1 += MOD;
                }
                if (y+1 <= min(x, N)) {
                    int m = max(dp[x][y+1][0], dp[x][y+1][1]);
                    d1 = max(d1, (1 + d2 - m + dp[x][y+1][1]) % MOD);
                    if (d1 < 0) d1 += MOD;
                }
                d1 %= MOD;
                if (d1 < 0) d1 += MOD;
                d2 %= MOD;
                if (d2 < 0) d2 += MOD;
                
                dp[x][y][0] = d1;
                dp[x][y][1] = d2;
            }
        }
        
        int ans = max(dp[0][0][0], dp[0][0][1]);
        out << ans << endl;
    }
};

int main() {
    InputReader in(cin);
    TaskF solver;
    solver.solve(in, cout);
    return 0;
}
